'''Maruuk's Nook''' was a concealed bolthole that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giaca]]. The hideout was located sixty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the surface of a canyon and it consisted of a network of caves, the largest of which was just big enough to land a small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in. The nook was sizable enough to house about a dozen people and over the years, it served as a residence to various criminals, hermits, outlaws and refugees.<ref name="TUR" />
